section: Andhra Pradesh - drainage: Godavari, Krishna, Penna, Vamsadhara, Nagavali; reservoirs and canals

River basin shares and longest river of AP

accepted.s: Which one of the following schemes carries surplus Krishna water to Chennai for drinking-water supply?
accepted.x: The Telugu Ganga Project carries surplus Krishna water to Chennai in Tamil Nadu for drinking-water supply.
accepted.tq: Use the purpose-beneficiary link to distinguish closely related Andhra Pradesh water schemes.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Telugu Ganga irrigates parts of Rayalaseema and Nellore.
2. Telugu Ganga supplies drinking water to Chennai.
3. Telugu Ganga carries Godavari water to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Telugu Ganga serves Chennai and also irrigates Rayalaseema and Nellore. The diversion of Godavari water to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage is the function of Pattiseema.
accepted.tq: Separate schemes by their source river, destination and beneficiary.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Pattiseema lift scheme transfers Godavari water to the Krishna at which location?
accepted.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal, which carries it to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage.
accepted.tq: Identify the destination structure in a river-transfer scheme.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Pattiseema is primarily classified as a:
accepted.x: Pattiseema is a lift irrigation scheme that transfers Godavari water into the Polavaram Right Main Canal.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a lift scheme, a canal and a dam project.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As reported for the season up to 10 August 2026, the Pattiseema scheme had diverted approximately:
accepted.x: Pattiseema had diverted 17.52 tmc ft of water by 10 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the precise project figure from nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi — Lift from Srisailam to Rayalaseema
KC Canal — Krishna flood water to Chittoor
accepted.x: Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi lifts water from Srisailam to Rayalaseema. Galeru-Nagari serves Kadapa and Chittoor with Krishna flood water; the KC Canal begins at Sunkesula; Veligonda links Srisailam with the Gundlakamma basin.
accepted.tq: Use the purpose and beneficiary to reject swapped scheme descriptions.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Galeru-Nagari Project is intended to carry Krishna flood water to:
accepted.x: Galeru-Nagari carries Krishna flood water to Kadapa and Chittoor districts.
accepted.tq: Recall the beneficiary districts of a regional irrigation scheme.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Kurnool-Cuddapah Canal takes off from Sunkesula on the:
accepted.x: The KC Canal originates at Sunkesula on the Tungabhadra and serves Kurnool and Kadapa.
accepted.tq: Link the canal’s headworks with its source river and beneficiaries.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Polavaram Left Main Canal is correct?
o: It carries Pennar water to Chennai through Poondi.
It carries Tungabhadra water to Kurnool and Kadapa.
It carries Krishna water to Rayalaseema through the Nallamala tunnels.
It carries Godavari water to North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.x: The Polavaram Left Main Canal carries Godavari water towards North Coastal Andhra and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the left and right canal functions through their destination regions.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Veligonda Project is associated with the movement of water from Srisailam to the:
o: Pennar basin through the KC Canal
Krishna delta through the Buckingham Canal
accepted.x: Veligonda carries water from Srisailam to the Gundlakamma basin through tunnels in the Nallamala hills.
accepted.tq: Test source, destination and engineering route together.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The priority Godavari-Cauvery link proposed by NWDA follows which sequence?
accepted.x: The proposed sequence is Godavari at Inchampalli, Krishna at Nagarjunasagar, Pennar at Somasila and Cauvery at Grand Anicut.
accepted.tq: Follow the river sequence from upstream source to downstream recipient basins.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the National Perspective Plan, the number of proposed river links is:
accepted.x: The National Perspective Plan contains 30 links: 16 Peninsular and 14 Himalayan.
accepted.tq: Check both the total and the component figures before selecting the option.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the first river-linking project under implementation?
accepted.x: Ken-Betwa is identified as the first river-linking project under implementation.
accepted.tq: Use the exact status description rather than merely identifying a proposed link.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh’s 2026 water plans:
1. The proposed intra-linking begins from Vamsadhara towards the Penna.
2. The Vamsadhara-Nagavali link is targeted for completion by December.
3. About 200 TMC of Godavari water is proposed to reach the Nagarjunasagar ayacut through Nallamala Sagar and Veligonda.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements describe the stated 2026 Andhra Pradesh water-linking plans.
accepted.tq: Verify several components of a current policy plan without confusing proposed links.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: National Waterway-4 connects:
accepted.x: National Waterway-4 is the Kakinada-Puducherry waterway. The Buckingham Canal, forming part of this system, passes through Pulicat Lake.
accepted.tq: Recall the two terminal points of the designated waterway.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Buckingham Canal passes through:
accepted.x: The Buckingham Canal passes through Pulicat Lake.
accepted.tq: Use a nearby-lake distractor set to test the exact location.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Polavaram Project is correctly described as a:
o: Canal project on the Tungabhadra under Section 90 of the Environment Protection Act
Lift scheme on the Pennar under the National Waterways Act
Multipurpose dam on the Krishna and a National Project under Section 89 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
Multipurpose dam on the Godavari and a National Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
accepted.x: Polavaram is a multipurpose Godavari dam and a National Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014. Section 89 is not the applicable provision stated for it.
accepted.tq: Watch for the statutory-section swap, a common wrong-authority and wrong-provision trap.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: From 1 April 2014, the Centre is to bear what proportion of the remaining irrigation cost of Polavaram Project?
accepted.x: The Centre bears 100 percent of the remaining irrigation cost of Polavaram from 1 April 2014.
accepted.tq: Test the exact percentage rather than a commonly assumed cost-sharing ratio.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly gives the design features of Polavaram Project?
o: 149.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 690 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Pennar
194.6 TMC storage, 2.70 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 18 TMC diversion to the Krishna
294.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Godavari delta
194.6 TMC storage, 7.20 lakh acres irrigation, 960 MW power and 80 TMC diversion to the Krishna
accepted.x: The design figures are 194.6 TMC storage, irrigation potential of 7.20 lakh acres, 960 MW generation and diversion of 80 TMC to the Krishna.
accepted.tq: Match a project with its complete set of capacity figures and intended diversion.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Polavaram Project was first proposed under which name by Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy?
accepted.x: Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy first proposed the project as Ramapada Sagaram.
accepted.tq: Associate the original project name with its proposer.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the reported 2026 progress, Polavaram was targeted for dedication by:
accepted.x: The project was reported to be 89 percent complete and targeted for dedication by March 2027, before the Pushkarams. An earlier progress figure was 78.64 percent in December 2024.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current progress target from the earlier progress figure.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The earlier reported progress of Polavaram Project in December 2024 was:
accepted.x: The earlier progress figure reported for December 2024 was 78.64 percent; the later figure was 89 percent.
accepted.tq: Separate a dated historical figure from the later progress update.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Left Main Canal of Polavaram was planned to supply how much water to the Visakhapatnam region, including water for the Kanithi reservoir?
accepted.x: The plan provides 27 TMC for the Visakhapatnam region, including 5 TMC to the Kanithi reservoir at the steel plant.
accepted.tq: Read the total and sub-allocation together to avoid reversing the figures.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Polavaram Left Main Canal:
1. It was planned to carry Godavari water to North Coastal Andhra on 2 September 2026.
2. The supply was to use pumps even though the dam itself was not complete.
3. It was planned to carry 27 TMC to the Visakhapatnam region.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements describe the reported Left Main Canal arrangement and its planned supply.
accepted.tq: Combine date, method and quantity in a current-affairs statement question.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: By 10 August 2026, approximately how much Godavari water was reported to have flowed to the sea while Pattiseema had diverted 17.52 tmc ft?
accepted.x: About 521 tmc ft of Godavari water was reported to have flowed to the sea during the period referred to.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a diversion figure from the much larger unutilised-flow figure.
accepted.sec: Canals, river linking and lift schemes → purpose and beneficiaries  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a State included in the Godavari basin list?
accepted.x: The listed Godavari basin States and region are Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka and Puducherry (Yanam). Tamil Nadu is not included in that list.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider in a basin-membership list.
accepted.sec: River basin shares and longest river of AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Krishna basin — Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka
2. Pennar basin — Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka
3. Palar basin — Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu
4. Budameru, Errakalava and Tammileru — Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs correctly state the basin-sharing regions listed for these rivers and streams.
accepted.tq: Check each basin’s participating States independently before choosing the coded combination.
accepted.sec: River basin shares and longest river of AP  [APPSC]

accepted.s: At Dowleswaram, the Godavari divides into which two principal distributaries?
accepted.x: At Dowleswaram, the Godavari splits into the two main distributaries, Gautami and Vasishta.
accepted.tq: Distinguish principal distributaries from the other mouths of the delta.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many principal distributaries does the Godavari form at Dowleswaram?
accepted.x: The Godavari forms two principal distributaries at Dowleswaram: Gautami and Vasishta. The delta is also described as having seven mouths in total.
accepted.tq: Separate the number of main branches from the total number of mouths.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following distributary-mouth pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Gautami reaches the sea at Yanam, while the Vasishta reaches the sea at Antarvedi. The other listed mouths are incorrectly paired.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure river-mouth pair and eliminate swapped locations.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the seven mouths of the Godavari delta?
accepted.x: The seven mouths include Gautami, Vasishta, Vainateya, Tulya, Bharadwaja, Kaushika and Athreya. Tammileru is a stream that drains into Kolleru Lake.
accepted.tq: Identify the non-member of a named distributary list.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Krishna River splits at Puligadda approximately how far below Vijayawada?
accepted.x: The Krishna splits at Puligadda, about 64 km below Vijayawada.
accepted.tq: Recall the precise distance associated with a river bifurcation point.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Diviseema is located:
o: Between the two branches formed when the Krishna splits at Puligadda
At the confluence of the Pennar and the Godavari
Between the Krishna and Tungabhadra at Sangameswaram
Between the Gautami and Vasishta branches of the Godavari
accepted.x: Diviseema, also called Divi island, lies between the two branches of the Krishna formed at Puligadda.
accepted.tq: Distinguish islands formed by the Krishna from delta features of the Godavari.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Hamsaladeevi is situated at the:
o: Confluence of the Tungabhadra and Krishna
accepted.x: Hamsaladeevi is situated at the mouth of the Krishna.
accepted.tq: Use the river-course position—source, confluence or mouth—to identify the feature.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Konaseema — Godavari delta between Gautami and Vasishta
accepted.x: Konaseema is the Godavari delta region between the Gautami and Vasishta branches. Diviseema and Bhavani Island are associated with the Krishna, while Gandikota is on the Penna.
accepted.tq: Match each island or landform with its river before checking its location.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The term ‘lankas’ in the Konaseema region refers to:
o: Sand dunes at the mouth of the Krishna
Canals linking the Krishna and Pennar
Rocky gorges formed by river erosion
Silt islands in the Godavari delta
accepted.x: The lankas are silt islands of the Godavari delta in the Konaseema region.
accepted.tq: Test the exact local geographical meaning of a distinctive term.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Bhavani Island is located on the Krishna near:
accepted.x: Bhavani Island is a Krishna river island near Prakasam Barrage at Vijayawada and is used as a tourism destination.
accepted.tq: Combine the river, nearby structure and city to identify the island.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The 1977 cyclone is specifically associated with which of the following features?
accepted.x: Diviseema is associated with the 1977 cyclone.
accepted.tq: Link a historical event with the correct geographical feature.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which river drains into Kolleru Lake?
accepted.x: Tammileru drains into Kolleru Lake.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a feeder stream from the major delta distributaries.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Sangameswaram in Kurnool is associated with the confluence of the:
accepted.x: Sangameswaram is the confluence of the Tungabhadra and Krishna rivers in Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Use the confluence pair to distinguish Sangameswaram from other river junctions.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Gandikota gorge is formed by the Penna River in:
accepted.x: Gandikota gorge, also called the Gandikota canyon, is formed by the Penna in YSR Kadapa district.
accepted.tq: Match the landform with its river and district.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Gandikota is identified as one of Andhra Pradesh’s tourism anchor hubs under the category of a:
accepted.x: Gandikota is a canyon or gorge on the Penna and is recognised as one of the tourism anchor hubs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a natural river canyon from deltaic and reservoir features.
accepted.sec: River landforms - distributaries, islands, canyon, lake, confluences  [APPSC]
